entities.name: Web3D Consortium
entities.note: The non-profit organization that develops and maintains the X3D standard.

entities.name: ACM SIGGRAPH
entities.note: A special interest group of the ACM focusing on computer graphics and interactive techniques.

entities.name: Khronos Group
entities.note: An industry consortium creating open standards for 3D graphics, including glTF.

entities.name: Metaverse Standards Forum
entities.note: A venue for cooperation between standards organizations and companies to foster interoperability.

entities.name: W3C
entities.note: The World Wide Web Consortium, responsible for web standards including WebXR.

entities.name: AOUSD
entities.note: The Alliance for OpenUSD, promoting the standardization of the Universal Scene Description.

entities.name: Web3D Korea Chapter
entities.note: A regional chapter of the Web3D Consortium based in South Korea.

entities.name: X3D 4.0
entities.note: The latest major version of the Extensible 3D Graphics standard.

entities.name: X3D 3.3
entities.note: The previous major version of the X3D standard.

entities.name: glTF
entities.note: A standard file format for three-dimensional scenes and models.

entities.name: WebXR
entities.note: A web API for accessing virtual reality and augmented reality devices.

entities.name: OpenUSD
entities.note: An open-source 3D scene description framework developed by Pixar.

entities.name: Web3D Conference
entities.note: The annual international conference on 3D web technology.

entities.name: Web3D 2023
entities.note: The 28th International Conference on 3D Web Technology held in San Sebastian, Spain.

entities.name: Web3D 2022
entities.note: The 27th International Conference on 3D Web Technology held in Evry, France.

entities.name: Web3D 2021
entities.note: The 26th International Conference on 3D Web Technology held virtually from Pisa, Italy.

entities.name: Web3D 2020
entities.note: The 25th International Conference on 3D Web Technology held virtually from Seoul, South Korea.

entities.name: Web3D 2019
entities.note: The 24th International Conference on 3D Web Technology held in Los Angeles, co-located with SIGGRAPH.

entities.name: SIGGRAPH
entities.note: The premier annual conference on computer graphics.

entities.name: SIGGRAPH 2023
entities.note: The 50th annual SIGGRAPH conference held in Los Angeles.

entities.name: SIGGRAPH Web3D BOF
entities.note: An annual Birds of a Feather session at SIGGRAPH dedicated to Web3D and X3D updates.

entities.name: SIGGRAPH Asia
entities.note: The Asian iteration of the annual SIGGRAPH conference.

entities.name: IEEE VR
entities.note: The IEEE Conference on Virtual Reality and 3D User Interfaces.

entities.name: Eurographics
entities.note: The annual conference of the European Association for Computer Graphics.

entities.name: Web3D Hackathon
entities.note: Periodic collaborative programming events organized to develop X3D tools and examples.

entities.name: Web3D Town Hall
entities.note: Public meetings hosted by the Web3D Consortium to discuss community goals and standard updates.

entities.name: Khronos 3D Commerce BOF
entities.note: A session focusing on 3D standards for retail and e-commerce, often featuring cross-talk with Web3D.

entities.name: Don Brutzman
entities.note: A key architect of the X3D standard and co-chair of the X3D working group.

entities.name: Nicholas Polys
entities.note: President of the Web3D Consortium and active researcher in Web3D technologies.

entities.name: Anita Havele
entities.note: Executive Director of the Web3D Consortium.

entities.name: Vince Marchetti
entities.note: Co-chair of the Web3D Consortium Board of Directors.

entities.name: Richard Puk
entities.note: A long-time contributor to X3D specifications and co-chair of the X3D working group.

entities.name: X3DOM
entities.note: An open-source JavaScript framework for integrating X3D into HTML5.

entities.name: X_ITE
entities.note: A WebGL-based X3D player for rendering 3D scenes in web browsers.

entities.name: Castle Game Engine
entities.note: A cross-platform 3D and 2D game engine supporting X3D.
